quote: Participants were adult native English speakers who gave written informed consent to participate. The experiment took about 10 minutes to complete. The data were recorded using anonymized participant codes, and none of the results included any identifying information. There were 150 participants total. The data from 10 of those participants were excluded due to failure to follow the instructions (assessed with catch trials).
guideline: Participants were asked to rate the literalness of the highlighted element. Participants were asked to rate literalness on a scale from 1 ('Not literal at all') to 6 ('Completely literal').
